name: Hero's Call Board: the High-Risk category lists the High-Risk quests only for the High-Risk ruleset
contract: The High-Risk call board quests require the High-Risk ruleset aura (1004019), and the faction quests also require their board's team. On the Hero's Call Board (gameobject 402000, Stormwind) a level-70 Human with the aura gets a fourth category option, High-Risk Quests, next to PvE, Profession and PvP Quests. It lists the always-offered Karazhan quest 420460 together with the day's and week's pooled dailies and weeklies, at most 14 quests (6 shared and 2 Alliance dailies, 3 weeklies and the 3 unpooled level-70 quests), and none of the PvE dailies such as 18017. Accepting 420460 adds it to the log. The Alliance-only daily 980019 is takeable, the Horde-only daily 980204 is not, and a shared daily 8200169 is. A level-70 Human without the aura sees only the three ordinary categories and can take none of the High-Risk quests.
